metadata.title: Software Supply Chain Security

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for constraining risk arising from third‑party software, build tools, and external SDLC inputs without granting deployment or runtime trust.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Third‑party libraries, packages, build tools, images, IaC modules, policy‑as‑code, and external SDLC components.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Solution pattern governing ingestion and integrity of software supply chain inputs.

props.name: data-pattern
props.remarks: Defines supplier metadata, dependency manifests, provenance attestations, integrity evidence, and tooling inventories as trust‑relevant data.

props.name: nist-controls
props.remarks: Software Supply Chain Security implements supply chain risk management and integrity‑related controls.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management Practices.

metadata.remarks: Software Supply Chain Security governs external software inputs to the SDLC, including dependencies, tooling, and build components. Supply chain integrity, provenance, or approval does not imply trust, safety, deployment authorization, or runtime permission.

components.title: Third‑Party Software Identification
components.description: Identifies and inventories third‑party software components, libraries, packages, tools, and images used within SDLC workflows.

techniques.name: Supply Chain Compromise
techniques.remarks: Insertion of malicious components into third‑party software or tooling.

techniques.name: Dependency Analysis
techniques.remarks: Enumeration and classification of third‑party software components.

components.title: Supply Chain Risk Evaluation
components.description: Assesses risk associated with third‑party software suppliers, tooling, and dependencies prior to SDLC consumption.

techniques.name: Risk Analysis
techniques.remarks: Assessment of third‑party supplier and component risk.

components.title: Artifact Provenance Verification
components.description: Verifies origin, authenticity, and chain‑of‑custody of third‑party software and build inputs.

techniques.name: Subvert Trust Controls
techniques.remarks: Forging or manipulating provenance to make malicious software appear legitimate.

techniques.name: Provenance Capture
techniques.remarks: Recording and validating source and chain‑of‑custody metadata.

components.title: Build Toolchain Integrity
components.description: Ensures integrity of compilers, build systems, pipelines, and automation used in SDLC processes.

techniques.name: Stage Capabilities
techniques.remarks: Compromised tooling used to inject malicious functionality during builds.

techniques.name: Artifact Verification
techniques.remarks: Integrity checks for build tools and outputs.

components.title: Software Supply Chain Non‑Equivalence Constraints
components.description: Defines what software supply chain controls do not grant or imply.
components.remarks: Verified provenance, acceptable risk ratings, or approved suppliers do not imply deployability, safety, execution permission, or runtime trust.
